list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before the bounty opened (see sources)
note: Names and descriptions are PlayStation's official wording. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each trophy names the published guides its facts come from. The game launched 19 November 2026, so where a detail is still unconfirmed we say so instead of inventing it.

pushsquare.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

keengamer.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

egamers.label: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all unlocked, so there is no separate task to do for it. Everything is offline and single-player, no DLC or online play is needed, and one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum at difficulty 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, with the 100% completion trophy the longest job by far. Keep the other guides in this list as your checklist and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — it is the first mission of the game, and the trophy pops when it ends. There is nothing to prepare and no choice to get wrong; just follow the mission through.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens with its first mission, What's in the Bag? Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing this guide flags as possibly missable: the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). PowerPyx notes the story takes 60 to 80 hours across its five chapters.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where you first get to switch between Jason and Lucia after the mission Coffee Break, which also unlocks the partner trophies and the Scooter Bros app, so keep playing naturally and those systems open up here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; PowerPyx reports it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is the busiest chapter for unlocks: bank jobs and payday loan jobs open after Credit Check, the Key Cloner arrives with Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, and Yasmani's jewelry jobs unlock the Snap Gun.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx reports it pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is... in this chapter is the one to watch: it introduces the large bank vault robberies that the Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play trophies need.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the final mission of the story and the gold pops. After the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida with everything still open — there is no mission replay, but nothing you need for the platinum is locked behind the ending, so the real cleanup starts here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run — just play the mission to its end. No preparation, no side requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission through; the heist itself teaches the robbery systems that the later bank and vault trophies build on.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Nothing outside the mission is required.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Play it through; no side task feeds into it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport itself matters for a later trophy, Catch Me If You Can, but that one is done in free roam, not here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the mission-name trophies, so by the time it pops you are one step from the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy. The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress you make during the story already counts, so play normally and check it after the credits. PowerPyx stresses it is not true 100%: it is closer to 60% of everything, most requirements ask for only part of a set (15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts). The few things it wants in full are the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting range gold medals, 42 drone time trials and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable — every item can still be done in free roam. Budget around 100 hours for this stage alone, per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — you can mix the four kinds however you like. Push Square breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridges runs the quickest to grind. Track them on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 and this trophy lands on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. You can see which you have done under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and the story introduces most of them for you. PowerPyx says you will almost certainly finish this by accident while working on the other trophies, so do not grind it — just check the list if it has not popped by the endgame.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. Push Square names the two ranges as Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, and notes most challenges have three difficulty tiers, some locked until you meet their conditions. Find them on the map under Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track progress under Touchpad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 golds, so this is not optional for the platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total, per PowerPyx). Push Square notes some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. See them on the map under Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone time trials finished, so the race wins and the time trials are worth doing together.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race twice does not count twice. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice. Track them under Touchpad, then Activities, then Racing. Most locations let you hire a car; Push Square advises watching your car's rating if you bring your own, and improving it with upgrades from mod shops. Pick the short, easy circuits first and leave the hard ones alone.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing challenge marked with a purple icon on the map west of Key Lento. Push Square says the ask is a parrotfish over 2 kg: fish in the marked area until you land one big enough. You need a boat and a fishing rod — there are boats nearby you can borrow if you do not own one yet. This is Cal's first fishing challenge, not a story mission, so it can be done whenever the text arrives.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. PowerPyx says you must finish all of a game's levels at least once, but you do not need to beat its extra challenges — pick the game you find easiest. It is available from Chapter 1, though the home TV is briefly unavailable during some story sections; it is still there after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls while you are playing as Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. PowerPyx lists the five quests as Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieving the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meeting at the warehouse) — the last one pops the trophy. The whole strand stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline, whose final mission is Maritime Disputes (per Push Square). Kenton is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls and gets a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure: he marks purple chest icons, you find the wrecks with the metal detector and bring the haul back. PowerPyx says he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared across several sets. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3 — as Jason you can hurry it along by calling Brian — so he is not missable. Track him under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, whose final mission is Hometown Heroes (per Push Square). It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. PowerPyx lists the five quests as Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (stealing the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. The catch, per PowerPyx, is that only certain questlines count: the named-character strands such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. The strands PowerPyx confirms as counting are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts: Skunk Apeology 101, searching for tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street racing and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his delivery runs) — and PowerPyx says there are more strangers yet to be discovered, so keep talking to strangers after the story. Your count is visible in the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner — that delivery counts as the first of 16 sports cars he wants. PowerPyx lists the rest (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City; delivering it in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is only available as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for the Kitty Litter synthetic labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter and Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This (shutting down the labs) — finishing that pops the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. PowerPyx notes you can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at a spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you cannot do the final one until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, walks out to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt and do the balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx warns it is still unconfirmed whether that balcony session is actually required for the trophy, since it is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, but it is the only one that can vanish, so do it while you can. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 spots are needed. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played, per Push Square.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is exclusive to Jason and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring the animals you hunt back to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. PowerPyx notes there are 15 target decks in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, but it is still unconfirmed which exact animal pops this trophy — do Bret's quests in order and it will come. Track them under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — 480 cards in total across the game, per the 100% checklist guides. Push Square notes you can sell cards you have collected at pawn shops and they still count toward your progress, so do not be afraid to cash them in. Track sets under Touchpad, then Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. If you are going for 100% completion you need 15 sets anyway, so this trophy lands on the way there.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up, then R1 to scan). Push Square breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so there are more than 100 to choose from — any 100 count. Track your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this is shared progress.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. View them all under Touchpad, then Progress, then Challenges. PowerPyx advises leaving this for late: many challenges complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, and since the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, you get to skip the 10 hardest ones entirely. When it is one of your last trophies, pick the easiest remaining challenges off the list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone. It is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with both characters: call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. PowerPyx's easy escape is a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you — and the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. You will probably also get it for free during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is..., since the bank vault robberies there hand you a 4-star wanted level as a matter of course.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — the trick is to stay in the flashing wanted state and never let it drop to nothing, and never let it rise into the full red heat level. It is only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs if you can, and keep moving. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop — and if it does not come, hit a fourth shop and keep going. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch, and the fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning alone counts, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Push Square adds that simply getting inside a vehicle discovers it too. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning after this pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus: while aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to slow time and highlight weak points, then land the kills before the purple focus bar runs out. PowerPyx's setup is to top up focus first (eat, drink, or wash up at home), carry Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and take them down without missing. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang enemies. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — it gets easier late in the game, and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. PowerPyx says the easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head for the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge, whose door leads straight inside. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane back to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank, a Rhino. PowerPyx places them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, with the tanks standing in the south of the base. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so bring armor and a fast getaway vehicle for the approach.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors. Then pick a jewelry store (PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City) and go in through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm, so use the gadget prompt instead. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly; the trophy pops shortly after you are out. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently once unlocked.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. It starts with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and walks you through the first vault: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, slip in while the guard opens the vault, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold Right to hand off a bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips about security vans (after his earlier quests), follow the purple van icons and repeat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — PowerPyx's escape is a fast motorcycle, then switching vehicles to go unrecognized — and a single bank can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens the bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is..., counts for this too: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault is treated as robbing the truck. If you want it earlier, PowerPyx says armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and he becomes a fence after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. PowerPyx's advice is to do it by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. It is pure exploration, so it pairs well with the stunts, WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries — sweep the fog while you do those and the map will fill in on its own. There is no checklist of places to visit; the map itself shows what is left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs — scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed. For the 100% checklist you need all 39 anyway, so this trophy pops early in that grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you. That is the whole trophy — a small breather of a task, and a good one to do while you are in Vice City for the races or the vehicle showroom. PowerPyx's screenshots show the bar on the rooftop; order the named drink, not just any cocktail.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. Two conditions matter: it must be that specific blue Banshee, not any other car, and you can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass and keep going down the street — the pop is slightly delayed. PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The location is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. PowerPyx stresses it is not missable: if you miss a valuable during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then a character, then Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. PowerPyx's method is a gym membership at a fitness club — filter for them on the map under Activities — and always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle): while you actively work out with one character, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. Home workouts after the story work too.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the game counts them, and you can see your total by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on criminal profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. The profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and finally Irredeemable, which is permanent — PowerPyx warns against letting it go that far, since police get far more aggressive. It builds passively through robberies and fights, so do not farm it until the end; if you are still short, PowerPyx's fallback is running over civilians and police with a car, which counts fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest answer: as of 20 November 2026 this trophy's unlock is still unconfirmed. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with a working theory that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, Vice City — possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner — but that is a guess, not a verified method. Do not waste time grinding it on a hunch; check the PowerPyx guide (linked below) for updates as players confirm it, and treat anything you read elsewhere as unverified until two guides agree.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx places it on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, and you must go alone. The spawn is slightly random: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, sometimes not — if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. PowerPyx's advice is to do it somewhere crowded, such as Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are packed together — ride slowly through the crowd and kick as you pass. It is a melee drive-by, so you stay on the bike the whole time; if the timer runs out before ten, just ride to the next crowd and try again. The wanted level this causes is a nuisance, not a blocker.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — it does not need to be in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder the bills at all. Then rob banks and payday loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; PowerPyx says Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It comes naturally from the robbery grind for the 100% checklist, and the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is....

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — it is cumulative, across every purchase you make in the game. PowerPyx says the fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There is no shortage of places to spend it (PowerPyx counts 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores), so this usually pops on its own while you gear up for the other trophies. If it is your last one, buy the priciest weapon mods and vehicle upgrades you have been putting off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties — they cost $160,000 in total. There are also 4 story-related garages, but only the 8 purchasable ones count. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy them through the app. PowerPyx's money advice is to fund them from robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Owning garages also feeds the On the Spot trophy, which needs their parking spots.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots, and you need the space before you can register. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register in his garage. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so PowerPyx suggests cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.

facts.label: Playthroughs
facts.value: 1 — no online trophies, no DLC needed

facts.label: Cheats
facts.value: Cheats disable trophies and saving — leave them off

stages.title: Play the story — 60 to 80 hours
stages.text: Finish Chapters 1 to 5 and enjoy it. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends — the only possibly missable trophy. Take optional missions as they appear, scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars; all of it counts toward 100% later. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots, no mission replay).

stages.title: 100% Completion — about 100 hours
stages.text: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the checklist: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 vaults, 100 optional tasks, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Most trophies pop during this stage.

stages.title: Cleanup — 10 to 20 hours
stages.text: Finish the 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands, the five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the robbery trophies and the money trophies (Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes, On the Spot). Check Bad Luck, I Guess last — its unlock is still unconfirmed. Then the platinum pops.
